title.en: A project browser that survives a failed request
title.zh: 让项目浏览器在请求失败时仍然可用

body.en: The portfolio fetches public repositories from GitHub, but a failed request should not leave the page empty. It starts with a curated collection and uses the last successful response when one is available.
body.zh: 作品集从 GitHub 获取公开仓库，但请求失败不应让页面变空。页面先提供精选项目，并在可用时使用上一次成功响应。

body.en: Unknown statistics stay unknown. Featured fallback cards do not invent star counts or update dates, and the interface explains which data is being shown.
body.zh: 未知统计值保持未知。备用卡片不会虚构星数或更新时间，界面也会说明当前数据来源。

body.en: The browser checks exercise success, failure, and cached recovery separately. That makes the fallback part of the product rather than a rarely tested error screen.
body.zh: 浏览器检查分别覆盖成功、失败与缓存恢复，让备用流程成为产品的一部分。

title.en: Bringing Modern Campus to a personal workspace
title.zh: 将 Modern Campus 带入个人空间

body.en: MicroHub’s off-white surfaces, navy text, and teal controls set the direction. The portfolio adapts these tokens to a desktop sidebar, a mobile navigation bar, and project cards.
body.zh: MicroHub 的米白底色、深蓝文字与青绿色控件确定了方向。作品集将这些设计变量应用于桌面侧栏、移动导航与项目卡片。

body.en: The workspace illustration is a local SVG. The avatar has smaller WebP variants so a tiny profile image does not require the original full-size file.
body.zh: 工作台插画使用本地 SVG。头像提供较小的 WebP 版本，避免小尺寸头像也下载完整原图。

body.en: The implementation includes visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion support, and browser checks at phone, tablet, and desktop widths.
body.zh: 实现包含可见键盘焦点、减少动态效果支持，以及手机、平板和桌面宽度的浏览器检查。
